meta.title: Resources & prompts
meta.description: Manage your resource library and saved prompt in one place.

resource-library.title: Resource library
resource-library.name: Resource name
resource-library.pathPlaceholder: Enter a file or folder path
resource-library.notePlaceholder: What this resource is used for
resource-library.empty: No resources yet. Add one file or folder to get started.
resource-library.firstStepsTitle: Get started with your first resource
resource-library.firstStepsBody: Add the file or folder the AI should refer to. Choose when it is read, then save. You can start with the defaults.
resource-library.advancedHelp: Optional: control file filters, reading size, and test a sample question.
resource-library.readModeHelp: Every AI request is simplest. Choose keyword trigger to read only when a question contains one of your keywords.
resource-library.choosePathHelp: Choose one file, or a folder to include matching files.
resource-library.noResourcesYet: Add a file or folder to give the AI trusted reference material.
resource-library.libraryPaused: The whole library is paused. Enable it below to include resources in AI requests.
resource-library.defaultModeHelp: Recommended for most people: read this resource before every AI request.
resource-library.maxCharsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 200 to 200000.
resource-library.saveFailed: Could not save. Your draft has been kept.
resource-library.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response (HTTP {status}).
resource-library.browsePlaceholder: Enter a path and press Enter
resource-library.truncated: Content was truncated to its character limit.
resource-library.maxTotalChars: Maximum total characters per AI request
resource-library.totalInvalid: Enter a whole number from 500 to 400000.
resource-library.testHelp: Tests the saved library settings and resources. Save changes before testing.
resource-library.question: Question
resource-library.questionPlaceholder: Enter a question to check which resources would be read

prompt-manager.title: Prompt manager
prompt-manager.description: Manage one prompt for this profile. Saved changes apply to all subsequent AI requests in this profile.
prompt-manager.enableHelp: Turning this off keeps the saved text. Save to apply changes.
prompt-manager.placeholder: Enter your prompt here, or import a UTF-8 TXT or Markdown file.
prompt-manager.importHelp: UTF-8 .txt or .md only, up to 1 MiB. Import replaces the draft; save to apply it. 1 MiB is the storage limit; using the full prompt depends on the model’s context window.
prompt-manager.limit: The prompt exceeds 1 MiB. Shorten it before saving.
prompt-manager.invalidName: The file must have a simple file name without path separators.
prompt-manager.fileTooLarge: This file exceeds 1 MiB. Choose a smaller file.
prompt-manager.invalidUtf8: This file is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 and import it again.
prompt-manager.importFailed: Could not read this file. Your draft has been kept.
prompt-manager.imported: File imported into the draft. Save to apply it.
prompt-manager.loadFailed: Could not load the saved prompt.
prompt-manager.saveFailed: Could not save. Your draft has been kept.
prompt-manager.conflict: The saved prompt changed in another window. Your draft has been kept. Copy any text you want to keep, then reload the saved prompt and apply your changes again.
prompt-manager.reloadConfirm: Replace the current draft with the saved prompt? Unsaved changes will be lost.
prompt-manager.importConfirm: Replace the current unsaved draft with this file?
prompt-manager.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response.
prompt-manager.networkFailed: Could not connect to the server.
prompt-manager.empty: The prompt is empty. No prompt text will be added until you enter and save some text.
prompt-manager.snapshotHelp: Keep a named copy of the prompt that is saved now. Save edits above first if you want them in the copy.
prompt-manager.firstStepsTitle: Use a prompt in three steps
prompt-manager.firstStepsBody: Write or import your prompt, save your changes, then enable it and save again to apply it. You can keep snapshots before making changes.
prompt-manager.stepEnablePrompt: 3. Turn it on and save again
prompt-manager.snapshotSectionHelp: A snapshot is a saved checkpoint. Preview it before restoring; restore replaces the current saved prompt.
prompt-manager.savedEnabledStatus: After you save, this enabled prompt is added to future AI requests.
prompt-manager.savedDisabledStatus: After you save, this prompt stays stored but is not added to AI requests.
prompt-manager.snapshotDraftHelp: You have unsaved changes. Creating a snapshot keeps this draft and captures only the previously saved prompt.
prompt-manager.snapshotNameHelp: Use 1–80 characters; control characters are not allowed.
prompt-manager.snapshotNameInvalid: Enter a name with 1–80 characters and no control characters.
prompt-manager.snapshotCreated: Snapshot created from the saved prompt. Your draft is unchanged.
prompt-manager.snapshotCreateFailed: Could not create the snapshot. Your draft has been kept.
prompt-manager.snapshotLimit: The snapshot limit has been reached. Existing snapshots can still be previewed and restored.
prompt-manager.snapshotsEmpty: No snapshots yet. Name the saved prompt to keep a version you can restore later.
prompt-manager.snapshotNotFound: This snapshot is no longer available. Refresh the snapshot list.
prompt-manager.snapshotRestoreHelp: Restoring replaces the saved prompt and its enabled setting, and takes effect for subsequent AI requests.
prompt-manager.snapshotRestoreConfirm: Restore “{name}”? This replaces the saved prompt and its enabled setting immediately.
prompt-manager.snapshotRestoreDirtyConfirm: Restore “{name}”? Your unsaved changes will be discarded, and the saved prompt and its enabled setting will be replaced immediately.
prompt-manager.snapshotRestored: Snapshot restored and saved. The editor now shows the restored prompt.
prompt-manager.snapshotRestoreFailed: Could not restore the snapshot. Your draft has been kept.
